QF.id: AIFM CII Fund Performance and Benchmarking_47

question.text: Under SEBI Box 7.3(i), additional performance benchmarks (beyond the core category-level benchmark) may be created using objectively verifiable parameters. Which set below lists VALID parameters?

answer.text: Investor personality type, fund-manager astrology sign, broker preference.
Instrument of investment, tenure/vintage of the fund, focus sectors.
LP-country GDP growth, GP-family wealth, off-balance-sheet exposures.
Only SEBI-pre-approved parameters from a fixed list of five.

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Box 7.3 in the workbook (page 163), the benchmarking agency shall ensure that performance benchmarking is based on objectively verifiable parameters such as instrument of investment, tenure/vintage of the fund, and focus sectors. The text uses an inclusive "like... etc." formulation rather than a closed list, and customised reports may be requested. The Trap: Option A lists subjective and irrelevant attributes. Option C mixes non-observable and off-ledger items that are not objectively verifiable. Option D wrongly asserts a fixed five-parameter list - the workbook text is open-ended. Note: The parameter list and the open-ended "etc." phrasing are in Box 7.3(i) on page 163; customised performance reports may be requested by stakeholders.
